items.docs: Creates a new incident in OpsGenie. The request is processed asynchronously and returns a request ID that can be used to track the status of the incident creation. Available to Standard and Enterprise plan users.

params.name: query
params.description: Search query to filter incidents using OpsGenie query language.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of items to return.

items.docs: Returns a list of incidents matching the specified search criteria.

params.name: identifier

params.name: identifierType
params.description: Type of the identifier. Possible values are id or tiny. Default is id.
